events.title: Steward assessed “Dietary cholesterol from eggs raises LDL cholesterol in most adults”: supported

steps.text: The claim rests on one empirical premise: that absorbed dietary cholesterol raises serum LDL. Meta-analyses of feeding trials show a modest, dose-dependent rise. Supported, not verified: effect sizes vary and hyper-responders complicate “most adults”.
create_subclaim: “Absorbed dietary cholesterol raises serum LDL in feeding trials”
